text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Of course! And so, here's some 
fortune-boosting advice to make Tarumae's 
birthday a happy one...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—...Is what I thought, but just for today, 
none of that matters!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No feng shui or anything, just a gift that 
I simply thought was really nice—here!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? N-No! Not this one! Wait, why did I 
even bring this with me~!?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Huhh~!? ...Sorry, I might've 
forgotten the present back in my room.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I was gonna present Tarumae with a hat 
that looks great on her with a TA-DA! and 
make her so happy, but...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu...! You don't have to worry about 
it anymore.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Just knowing you put so much thought into 
doing something for me, Rickey... makes me 
so happy already.
